subject: Request: one-time promotional bundle for incubator demo-day participants
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@launchfoundry.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partnerships@launchfoundry.org
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo support for our Oct 14 demo-day

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you’re well — LaunchFoundry is running an in-person demo-day on Oct 14 and we’d love Redwood to be a promotional partner. We’re expecting ~20 early-stage startups (pre-seed / seed) that will need hosted inference credits to demo live, and many will start POCs after the event.

Ask: could Redwood provide a one-time promotional bundle so each startup gets some onboarding runway? Ideal is something like $2k in hosted credits per startup, or an equivalent promo/discount on the Starter bundle. We’re open to alternatives (smaller credit + higher discount).

We can offer logo placement, a short on-stage mention, and introductions to a handful of teams for pilots. I attached a draft participant list and a one-page MOU outlining deliverables.

Quick questions for your team:
- Is a one-off promo like this possible under your current accelerator credits policy?
- Can credits be applied to new hosted accounts only, or is Dedicated allowed?
- What documentation do you need from our side (MOU, participant CSV, PO)?

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility you can offer.

Best,
Emma Li
Partnerships Lead, LaunchFoundry
emma@launchfoundry.org
+1 415-555-0198

Attachments: launchfoundry_participants_q32026.csv, signed_MOU_EmmaLi.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@launchfoundry.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo support for our Oct 14 demo-day

Hi Emma — thanks for the note and congrats on the lineup. I’ve looped in Ben (sales) and Laura (finance) to scope a possible promo structure and the billing path.

High-level: we often run cohort promos and trial credits for incubators, but one-off bundles require a quick internal sign-off (finance and sometimes legal). Ben — can you propose a short package and any limitations (transferability, expiry)? Laura — please confirm billing/FA requirements and if we need a PO or contract attachment.

Emma, we got the CSV and MOU — I’ll leave the details to Ben/Laura but aim to get you a concrete proposal by Monday EOD. If there’s any priority startup or a sponsored pilot, flag that in reply.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@launchfoundry.org>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo support for our Oct 14 demo-day

Emma / Vanessa — thanks for the context. I reviewed the participant sample and the MOU. Proposed options (pick one):

1) Demo-Day Credits (preferred, simple): $2,000 in hosted credits per startup for up to 20 startups (total face value $40,000). Credits expire 6 months from issuance, non-transferrable except by written exception from Redwood. Apply only to hosted API usage (not Dedicated).

2) Pilot Discount Package: 6-month 50% discount on Starter tier for accounts created via a LaunchFoundry promo code. Credits not issued; discount applied to hosted billing.

Notes / concerns:
- If you need credits to be transferable among cohort members (e.g., if one company declines), that’s a policy exception and needs finance/legal approval.
- We can do a combined approach: $1,000 credit + 3 months at 40% off to encourage early POCs while conserving promo budget.

Attached is a short proposal template I’d use for final sign-off. If you confirm option 1, Laura — can you advise the accounting flow and whether we need a consolidated invoice vs per-startup account setup?

Next steps: Emma to confirm preferred option, return signed MOU (looks good), and confirm whether startups will be onboarded as separate Redwood accounts or a single pooled account managed by LaunchFoundry.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Startups | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0122

Attachment: demo_day_proposal_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@launchfoundry.org>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo support for our Oct 14 demo-day

Thanks — quick finance notes before we commit:

- Billing path: Promo credits are easiest if issued against new, individual hosted accounts (credits applied at account level). We can also issue a bulk credit against LaunchFoundry’s partner account but that requires a PO and appropriate invoicing.
- Tax/AR: If credits are provided as a marketing allowance to LaunchFoundry (partner-billed), they are treated differently for VAT/US tax purposes; need partner legal entity info.
- Transferability: standard policy is non-transferable to avoid double-spend and accounting complications. I can approve transferability on a case-by-case basis up to 3 transfers total only if we get a simple attestation from LaunchFoundry and it’s documented in the MOU.
- Cap: we prefer to keep promotional exposure under $50k per event for standard partner approvals. Your face-value $40k fits that constraint but will require an internal promo code and tagging for usage tracking.

Please confirm: (A) whether startups will be created as separate accounts (preferred for tracking), (B) whether LaunchFoundry wants Redwood to invoice LaunchFoundry for an aggregate amount (we would need a PO), or (C) Redwood should create promo codes and instruct startups to sign up individually.

I’ve attached a short billing worksheet — if Emma returns the completed partner entity info we can finalize routing.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: billing_workbook_q3.xlsx
From: Emma Li <emma@launchfoundry.org>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo support for our Oct 14 demo-day

Thanks — we’re comfortable with Option 1 (the $2k credit per startup applied to hosted accounts). A few follow-ups: 

- Transferability: we’d like a one-off allowance that unclaimed credits can be reallocated to other cohort members prior to Nov 1 (we anticipate a few dropouts). A case-by-case attestation is fine — I’ve added language to the MOU.
- Account creation: startups will onboard as individual Redwood accounts using a promo code you provide. That’s simpler for them.
- Billing: we don’t need Redwood to invoice LaunchFoundry — we prefer promo codes per startup.

I’ve completed and uploaded the signed MOU here: https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/ABCDEF123456 and attached the final participant CSV (launchfoundry_participants_q32026.csv). If you can issue promo codes and share an onboarding playbook this week, we can start outreach and have teams onboarded before Oct 7.

Appreciate the quick help — let me know any final legal/ops items.

Best,
Emma
Emma Li
Partnerships Lead, LaunchFoundry

Attachments: launchfoundry_participants_q32026.csv
